The '''Bettok system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Velcar sector/Legends|Velcar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="eao" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bettok]].
